item.title: Containers, session storage and triggers: one session per delivery, and Pub/Sub redelivers once 429s are exhausted
item.description: The event-triggered deployment surface of ADK Go v2.4.0: the message contracts of the /apps/{app_name}/trigger/pubsub and /trigger/eventarc endpoints (base64 data, attributes merged in, CloudEvents structured versus binary modes), userID coming from the subscription or event.Source, one session per delivery with retries reusing it, 429 detection by error-string containment, exponential backoff with half jitter, a 500 after exhaustion so the upstream redelivers, ErrCompaction being logged without NACKing, the fact that the concurrency semaphore is never wired in the Pub/Sub controller, and why compaction is nearly pointless on the trigger surface.
